heroSummary: Cobb students begin August 4. Four Digital Learning Days are spread across the year, elementary and middle school conference week runs October 14–17, and all grade levels have early release at the end of both semesters.
seoTitle: Cobb County School Calendar 2025-2026: Holidays, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: Cobb County School District 2025-2026 calendar with first day, last day, holidays, breaks, digital learning days, early release, PDF, and ICS.
calendarNotes: Cobb County School District starts the 2025-2026 school year on Monday, August 4, 2025 and ends the student year on Wednesday, May 20, 2026. The official calendar marks Fall Break on September 22-26, Thanksgiving Break on November 24-28, Winter Break on December 22-January 2, Spring Holidays on April 6-10, student holiday/staff days on July 28-August 1, November 4, January 5, and May 21-22, digital learning days on August 18, October 13, December 2, and March 2, elementary and middle school conference week on October 14-17, and all-level early release days on December 18-19 and May 18-20.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Cobb County school start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school for Cobb County School District is Monday, August 4, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Cobb County in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school is Wednesday, May 20, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When are Cobb County Spring Holidays in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Holidays run Monday, April 6 through Friday, April 10, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Winter Break for Cobb County School District in 2025-2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs Monday, December 22, 2025 through Friday, January 2, 2026. January 5 is a student holiday/staff day.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Fall Break for Cobb County Schools in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break runs Monday, September 22 through Friday, September 26, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Cobb County have digital learning days in 2025-2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. The official calendar marks digital learning days on August 18, October 13, December 2, and March 2.

calendarFaqs.q: When are Cobb County early release days in 2025-2026?
calendarFaqs.a: All-level early release days are December 18-19, 2025 and May 18-20, 2026. Elementary and middle school conference week runs October 14-17 with early release for those levels only.

calendarFaqs.q: What is a student holiday/staff day on the Cobb calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: A student holiday/staff day is a no-school day for students while staff may have scheduled work, planning, or professional responsibilities.
